text:
jen: FYI — I'm going to split the big docs refactor into multiple PRs so we don't take the whole site down. plan is: PR1 redirects + tests, PR2 move files (/guides -> /reference/guides), PR3 update anchors and cross-links, PR4 cleanup + examples. Need reviewers and merge timing. who can take PR1 and PR2?

alex: I can do PR2 review. prefer to review after redirects are merged so previews show final paths.

maria: heads-up — some SDK snippets reference anchors in guides that will change. we need a mapping table in PR3 to update internal links and SDK snippet imports.

sam: agree with ordering. also suggest running the broken-link-checker on each deploy preview before merge. I can add a small GH action to fail CI for new broken anchors.

jen: thanks. tentative owners: PR1 (nate), PR2 (alex), PR3 (maria + alex), PR4 (jen). aim to merge over two business days to give time for previews and rollback if needed. anyone blocked by that schedule?

nate: ok for PR1. I'll add redirect rules and unit tests for the redirecter. will post preview when ready. ETA tomorrow morning PST.

docs-bot: deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-211--docs.redwood.ai — redirect tests failing (12 broken anchors)

alex: can you paste the top failures, docs-bot?

docs-bot: broken-link-checker report: /guides/streaming-api -> missing anchor #streaming-usage, /guides/sdk-auth -> missing anchor #token-rotation, several internal links still point to /guides/*

maria: those anchors moved into /reference/guides/streaming.md and were renamed. PR3 will include a CSV mapping like: old_path,old_anchor,new_path,new_anchor. please don't update the docs until PR1 and PR2 land or previews will 404.

jen: good call. nate, can PR1 include temporary redirects that map old anchors to the new anchors? example redirect config below.

nate: yep, can do. example: 

```yaml
redirects:
  - from: "/guides/*"
    to: "/reference/guides/:splat"
    status: 301
  - from: "/guides/streaming-api#streaming-usage"
    to: "/reference/guides/streaming#usage"
    status: 301
```

alex: perfect. once PR1 is merged, I'll re-run link-check locally against the new paths before approving PR2.

maria: I'll prepare the mapping file and a short script to bulk-rewrite anchors in PR3. will attach instructions for reviewers.

sam: small ops note — Helix CDN caches redirects aggressively. add cache-bust headers on the redirect responses during the rollout window so we can revert quickly if needed. I can add that to PR1 if you want.

nate: please do. I'll include a feature flag in the redirect middleware so we can toggle it.

jen: sweet. merge order recap: PR1 (redirects + cache-bust middleware) -> PR2 (file moves) -> PR3 (anchor updates + SDK snippet fixes) -> PR4 (cleanup, remove old stubs). reviewers: PR1: nate + sam, PR2: alex, PR3: maria + alex, PR4: jen. target: start PR1 tomorrow morning, merge by end of day if CI green. keep thread updated with preview links.

alex: I'll block 2 hours tomorrow afternoon for reviews.

maria: will open PR3 draft today so reviewers can eyeball mapping.

jen: thanks all. quick ask — if you see any external links (blog posts, partner docs) that depend on the old anchors, drop them in this thread so we can notify owners.

nate: noted — I'll run a sitewide search for /guides/ and post results here.

sam: ping @eng-sre for any CDN config changes after PR1 merges.

jen: done. will post a short checklist before each merge: 1) preview link 2) broken-link-checker report 3) redirect test results 4) reviewers approved 5) rollback steps.

alex: sounds good. thanks! :+1:

maria: thanks, everyone.

docs-bot: reminder scheduled 24h before PR1 merge window.
